gloss: overlooking; missing; letting pass; catch-up viewing

definitions.explanation: failing to see or notice something, whether accidentally or intentionally
watching a TV program after its original broadcast, typically via streaming services

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見逃|みのが}し⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up missing an important point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見逃|みのが}し⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a chance I absolutely cannot miss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見逃|みのが}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Overlooking small mistakes leads to big problems.

examples.japanese: {見逃|みのが}し⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched yesterday's drama on catch-up streaming.

examples.japanese: {見逃|みのが}し⟦{視聴|しちょう}→視聴：04467_shichou⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: The catch-up viewing service is convenient.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{見逃|みのが}す→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧ (to overlook, miss) → nominal form
- ⟦{見逃|みのが}す→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧ (to overlook, to let pass, to miss watching)

SENSE 1 - OVERLOOKING:
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without missing anything, thorough)
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦{厳禁|げんきん}→厳禁：18021_genkin⟧ (don't miss this, must-see)

SENSE 2 - CATCH-UP:
Modern streaming services offer {見逃|みのが}し⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧ (catch-up streaming) for people who missed the original broadcast:
- TVer (Japan's major catch-up platform)
- Various broadcaster apps

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧ (catch-up streaming/distribution)
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦{視聴|しちょう}→視聴：04467_shichou⟧ (catch-up viewing)
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ (free catch-up viewing)
